The '''''Crix''-class assault shuttle''', also designated '''A-2s''', was an assault vessel used by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and later by the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Crix''-class displayed certain characteristics of both [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] designs as well as some [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari]] features, given their cooperation on the design. The hulls showed the Mon Cal influence, while the interior, bridge and engines were very Corellian.<ref name="LECG" />

It had an armored shell with a narrow slot between the halves for the engines, cockpit and weapons. It also had a long, narrow fin mounted on the upper hull which contained powerful long-range communication arrays. The A-2s was heavily armed and shielded and possessed significant firepower. The area between the shells was ringed by a series of [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]], that could be fired automatically or by troopers aboard the ship. It also included four boarding ramps for rapid deployment of troopers and speeders. An alternate variant of the vessel, [[Crix-class diplomatic courier shuttle|''Crix''-class diplomatic courier shuttle]] or Dc-4a also existed, with lighter armor, firepower and shielding.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
The jointly-designed ''Crix''-class was named after [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]/[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], a choice made because of his [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] background and for his effort to save [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] during the [[Battle of Calamari|invasion]] of the [[World Devastator]]s over a century earlier.<ref name="LECG" />
